info.title: Keyrus Brain baseline transport
info.description: Current target transport. Better Auth (/api/auth/*) and the SPA fallback are not described here. Authentication: routes with an empty security list are public; every other route needs the stated credential. This document itself needs a signed-in credential. Command and query bodies are discriminated unions: see x-brain-commands and x-brain-queries.

humanSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
humanSession.description: Better Auth cookie name/prefix is set by the pinned production configuration; HTTPS may use its secure-prefixed cookie name. Ingress reads the vendor session API, not a manually parsed cookie.

localSetup.name: Authorization
localSetup.description: Setup <one-use credential from the private Governor setup.token file>; never a public default.

chatSignature.name: X-Brain-Signature
chatSignature.description: Brain or Slack request signature inside a 5 minute window; never a session.

metricsToken.description: BRAIN_METRICS_TOKEN_FILE token; the route does not exist when it is unset.

resumeFrom.description: Engine state saved by an earlier session (a checkpoint's engineState): the engine starts from it instead of an empty conversation, or refuses when it does not hold it.

EvaluationAssignment.description: Governor-created immutable inputs for one admitted evaluator job. Runner claims never create this authority.

Checkpoint.description: One checkpoint shape for engines and sessions: the commit and progress an attempt reached, the outputs it consumed and produced, effects still in flight and the brief version it worked from. Consumed outputs and brief version are stamped by the Governor.

engineState.description: Engine-native warm-start artifact (for example a Pi transcript), digest-pinned; never the source diff.

choices.description: Why the Governor chose this run's way of working, team member and model routes, as recorded when each choice was made (ADR 0065); empty when no such choice was made.

resumedFrom.description: The checkpoint a resumed session started from, and the runner that held it.

review.description: Whether the person asking can decide this review now, and the plain reason when not.

SessionResumeInput.description: Resumes a session from the checkpoint it saved: a new session starts on the runner that holds the checkpoint. Nothing else is chosen by the caller; the source session fixes the work item, the workflow and its input.

SessionDelegateInput.description: A bounded sub-task for a child session of the same mission (ADR 0053). A session delegates from itself (its own attempt's session) and names only the task; a person names the parent session. Budget and scope default to what the parent still has, and the child can only narrow them.

resume.description: Whether the session can be resumed from its checkpoint. `possible` is true only when the engine can resume, the checkpoint is held by a runner that is online and the work still wants it; `reason` says plainly why not when a checkpoint exists but cannot be used, and is absent when there is nothing to resume.

SessionPause.description: Whether one session can be paused at its next turn boundary and where that stands. `supported` is false when the engine cannot stop at a turn boundary (then `reason` says so in plain words). A paused session keeps its fence, lease and runner slot; `stopsAt` is when Brain stops it if nobody continues it (the hold limit), so the slot is not held forever.

SessionDetail.description: session.get snapshot: the BrainSession record extended with the execution-stream cursor and the interruption continuation facts.

resumedFrom.description: The checkpoint a resumed session started from, and the runner that held it.

Run.description: One execution of a released workflow: the aggregate behind every runId. Source of truth is the workflow_runs row; missionId and workItemId come from mission_runs and execution_links.

engineState.description: Engine-native warm-start artifact (for example a Pi transcript), digest-pinned; never the source diff.

SessionContext.description: What one session receives: the mission brief, its direct dependencies' handoffs, its pinned inputs, the messages delivered at its start and its last checkpoint.

delegations.description: The work this session's task delegated, with how each child's run stands, including a failure fact.

delegatedHandoffs.description: What delegated children handed back: claims from their sessions, never the task's own handoff.

DelegationRun.description: Where a delegated child's own run stands: waiting to start, running, finished with a result handed back to the parent, or failed with a reason the parent is told.

DelegationEvidence.description: The child's latest evidence bundle, which a delegation review decides on, and what an independent evaluator said of it.

EstimateBasis.description: Where an estimate figure comes from: the median of past runs (history), what the planner declared, or neither (unknown). A plan total over tasks with different bases is mixed. low and high are the 25th and 75th percentile of past runs when the sample is large enough, summed over tasks for a plan total.
